children: Private Bancorp of America, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with higher revenue and improved profitability versus the year-ago quarter, driven by rising net interest income and a strategic shift toward lower-cost core deposits.
Revenue: $43.4M total interest & dividend income for Q2 2026, up from $42.0M in Q2 2025; YoY change 3.3%.
Net income: $13.118M for Q2 2026, versus $10.449M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 25.6%.
Diluted EPS: $2.27 for Q2 2026, up from $1.77 in Q2 2025; YoY change 28.2%.
Revenue growth was led by higher net interest income, supporting stronger pre-tax, pre-provision revenue and improved profitability metrics.
The bank executed a strategic funding shift from brokered to core non-brokered deposits, boosting core deposit growth and reducing funding costs.
Growth remained relationship-driven across seven Southern California branches with continued emphasis on private banking, business banking, and SBA lending.
Operational investments increased in personnel, technology, and compliance to scale operations and support the transition to SEC/NASDAQ reporting.
Asset and credit management included active portfolio monitoring, focus on CRE and C&I concentrations, and updates to CECL model calibration.
